correctness.rationale: The occupied-color supports are 15 nonempty masks per shore, yielding exactly 225 ordered support pairs under the explicit deterministic mask map. An independent implementation detects only recurrent support classes fixed (1,1), alternating (5,10)<->(10,5), and full (15,15), with precisely 170,54,1 support-pair basin counts; all other masks enter in at most six steps. On recurrent supports each individual color rotates modulo four (or stays all zero), so microscopic period and entry time coincide with support entry. Alternating basin cardinality pairs have multiplicities (2,2):8,(2,3)/(3,2):10,(2,4)/(4,2):3,(3,3):12,(3,4)/(4,3):4, giving exact polynomial in surjection numbers U_j(n). The sharp 6-step support requires shore capacities >=3 and >=4. Independent direct microscopic iteration verified K2,2, K3,3, K3,4, K4,4 basins, including 32,1440,7272,36704 four-cycle-basin states. The 225-support exhaustion is a complete finite quotient for arbitrary graph sizes, not an incomplete sample.
